question: What is the latest GR on free 7/12 and 8A land record extracts through Aaple Sarkar centres?
gold_answer: The circular of 19-12-2019; no newer GR found in this corpus

gold_grs_detail.title: Guidelines for Free access to online 7/12 extract and 8A extract on Bhulekh Website through Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra

product.answer: The latest GR in the corpus on free 7/12 and 8A land record extracts through Aaple Sarkar centres is dated 19-12-2019, which issues guidelines for providing computed 7/12 and 8A extracts free of cost through Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra from the Bhulekh website and prohibits operators from verifying copies with a signature stamp.

product.answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024) changes the 19-12-2019 guidelines for free 7/12 and 8A land record extracts through Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra centres. The 19-12-2019 GR itself provides the latest guidance available in the corpus: it states that the free computed 7/12 and 8A extracts provided through Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra from the Bhulekh website are for information only, must not bear a signature or stamp verifying authenticity, and misuse should be reported to the Collector who forwards complaints to the IT department under the 19-01-2018 GR.
